# Issue 7: Add manual correction controls

## Summary

Allow users to correct detection mistakes before trusting a layout.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Rename object
- [ ] Change category
- [ ] Correct dimensions
- [ ] Change movable state
- [ ] Remove false detection
- [ ] Add missed object manually

## Notes

Manual corrections must survive save/reload and should be preserved during later rescan reconciliation whenever safely possible.
